Agency proposes new rule on equipment exports

The proposed rule would revise several entries on the control list, according to the notice published on Monday. Industry groups said they would submit comments before the deadline.

The comment period runs for sixty days. Officials declined to say when a final rule might follow, noting that prior revisions took between eight months and two years to complete after the initial notice.

Analysts said the scope of the revision was narrower than earlier reports had suggested, and pointed to the exclusion of several categories that had been discussed in industry briefings during the spring.
